overview: The Medford City Council approved appropriations of free cash and water/sewer enterprise funds, forwarded its fiscal year 2026 budget recommendations to the Mayor, and passed resolutions supporting Tufts University lecturers and municipal unions. The Council also referred residential zoning amendments to the Community Development Board and tabled discussions on a Fulbright Street sign appeal and the sale of city-owned land on McCormick Avenue.

items.title: Ceremonial Resolutions
items.summary: Approved a resolution celebrating the 50th wedding anniversary of Richard and Cheryl Montecalvo, and a memorial resolution for William "Billy" Oganeski that requested the Mayor dedicate a cemetery way in his honor.

items.title: Parking Department Committee of the Whole Resolution
items.summary: Approved a resolution to hold an April 8 Committee of the Whole meeting to review parking department matters, including surveillance technology, the Green Line Extension parking program, and ticket appeal policies.

items.title: Approval of Records and Committee Reports
items.summary: Approved meeting minutes from March 11 and March 19, 2025, alongside committee reports addressing safety improvements, accessory dwelling units, Medford Square zoning, and budget recommendations.

items.title: Zoning Ordinance Amendments for 10 and 20 Revere Beach Parkway
items.summary: Approved proposed text amendments to the Wellington Station Multifamily Overlay District dimensional standards, incorporating Community Development Board recommendations on building overhang limits.

items.title: Fulbright Street Sign Permit Appeal
items.summary: Tabled an appeal by AIM Realty Medford LLC regarding a sign permit denial at 42 Fulbright Street to await a legal review from the city's legal team.

items.title: Support for Tufts University Lecturers and Municipal Unions
items.summary: Passed resolutions supporting the Tufts University full-time lecturers union in contract negotiations and urging the Mayor to settle outstanding contracts with municipal unions.

items.title: FY 2026 Budget Public Engagement Plan
items.summary: Referred a resolution to design and implement a public engagement plan for the upcoming fiscal year 2026 budget to the Resident Services and Public Engagement Committee.

items.title: Residential Zoning District Amendments Referral
items.summary: Referred proposed zoning amendments creating new neighborhood and urban residential districts to the Community Development Board.

items.title: City Council FY 2026 Budget Recommendations
items.summary: Approved and forwarded the City Council's compiled budget recommendations for fiscal year 2026 to the Mayor.

items.title: Appropriation of Free Cash and Retained Earnings
items.summary: Approved the appropriation of $737,927.88 in free cash for fire station design debt and property revaluations, and $1.7 million in water and sewer retained earnings for the Arlington Street water main replacement project.

items.title: Conveyance of McCormick Avenue Parcels
items.summary: Tabled a proposed resolution to convey two city-owned parcels on McCormick Avenue to fund the Affordable Housing Trust Fund.

items.title: MWRA Water Bonds Loan Order
items.summary: Approved a loan order on third reading to authorize borrowing for the MWRA zero-interest lead line replacement program.

items.title: Public Participation on Charter Update
items.summary: Discussed the timeline and next steps for transmitting the Council's amended charter to the state legislature with a resident.
